[package]
workspace = "../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-deflate"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "First-party raw DEFLATE (RFC 1951) codec — resumable byte-granular inflate plus a real LZ77 + fixed-Huffman compressor. Relocated out of the replication wire contract so it is reachable by any framework module (e.g. a first-party PNG encoder), not only pack segment compression."

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "deflate"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
path = "🦀️.rs"

[dev-dependencies]
miniz_oxide = "0.8"
zip = { version = "2.4", default-features = false, features = ["deflate"] }
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"
